Author: T3chnicalD3ath Inc.
Name: Tekz Bard Helper
Description:
Coordinate a party of bards. The party leader clicks Host and shares a one-line invite; members paste it in to join. The leader can then switch the whole band - or one member - to any instrument, and sees who is connected, what they hold and whether the switch landed.

Security: the leader's plugin hosts the connection directly - no outside server. Joining needs the invite's secret code, the host only admits people in its party, and members only obey commands while the host is their current party leader. All traffic is encrypted.

Hosting needs the members to reach the leader's PC: same network works out of the box; across the internet, forward the shown port on the leader's router.

Use /tbh to open it.
Punchline: Run your party's band: the leader picks everyone's instrument from one panel.
